neighbours.label: the word that completes a statement of inability or limitation (not be able, wasn't able to get around very well, too short)
fire: I have a dentist appointment, so I will not be able to join you.
After the surgery she was not able to walk for weeks.
Many applicants were rejected because they were too young.
My grandfather can't hear very well anymore.
The boy was too small to ride the roller coaster.
Unfortunately we won't be able to deliver on Sunday.
The old printer is no longer able to print in colour.
He was too tired to finish the race.
quiet: I have a dentist appointment, so I will join you later.
After the surgery she walked every day for weeks.
Many applicants were accepted because they were qualified.
My grandfather listens to the radio every morning.
The boy was excited to ride the roller coaster.
Fortunately we will deliver on Sunday as planned.
The old printer still prints in colour.
He was happy to finish the race.
